Maya Patel: Quick qtr check — can we do a compact status on OKR milestone A (runtime v2 rollout) by end of day? shipped/slipped/owner/next?
Luca Moretti: Shipping: canary rollout completed for 20% of traffic. No perf regressions. :thumbsup:
Priya Desai: Slipped: dedicated autoscaler work hit serialization bug, pushed 2d. Owner: Priya. Blocker: needs eng-infra review of serialization patch.
Jordan Kim: CR ping @Priya — I can review after stand at 11:30. pls drop the PR link.
Priya Desai: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 — tests flaky locally, trying timeout tweak.
Sam Rogers: Note on embeddings pipeline: we've trimmed 12% token cost via cache hints; owner Sam. Will roll to prod canary tomorrow.
Maya Patel: Owners recap: Runtime rollout — Luca; Autoscaler fix — Priya; Embeddings cost — Sam. Dependencies: eng-infra review (prio), infra load testing window (Thu), product QA for regressions.
Luca Moretti: Next steps from runtime side: increase canary to 50% by EOD Friday if no regressions. I'll update console dash and add a canary monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy-status: runtime-canary v2.14 -> 20% (ok). tests: 0 failing. :robot_face:
Jordan Kim: For the autoscaler serialization fix, suggestion: try switching to `serde_json::to_vec` fallback — worked for similar case. I can help pair if you want.
Priya Desai: Thanks — pairing at 2pm works. Will try the fallback first and post results.
Maya Patel: Product asks for shipping note: if we hit 50% canary by Friday, we'll mark milestone as "partial ship" and document remaining autoscaler scope as follow-on. @Jordan @Luca please add short summary in the milestone doc.
Luca Moretti: Added summary to doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/q2/runtime-rollout — marked partial ship and next actions.
Sam Rogers: I'll schedule infra load test slot for Thu 10-12 and ping eng-infra channel.
Maya Patel: Awesome. If anything slips again, drop a one-line update here. Otherwise I'll consolidate status at 5pm PST.
Jordan Kim: :eyes: will update PR after pairing.
Priya Desai: pairing done — fallback worked, tests green locally. pushing patch now.
deploy-bot: deploy-event: autoscaler-fix branch CI -> passed. staging deploy queued.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — will close loop in the 5pm summary.
